### Astrobiyoloji

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Dünya dışındaki yaşamın nelere ihtiyaç duyabileceğini ve bilim insanlarının güvenilir kanıtları nasıl tanıyabileceğini keşfet.

Skills: 4

[conditionsForLife.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/conditionsForLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluating environments for life requires explicit biological and geochemical assumptions; familiar Earth conditions are useful evidence, not universal proof.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Hangi ortamların ve kimyasal süreçlerin yaşamı mümkün kılabileceğini düşün.

### Astronomik araçlar ve kanıtlar

Groups: 6 · Skills: 30

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomy infers properties of remote objects from electromagnetic radiation, gravitational effects, particles and spacecraft observations. This domain covers what an observation can reveal, how instruments and methods constrain the evidence, and how competing interpretations are evaluated, not the engineering construction of observatories and spacecraft.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Gökbilimcilerin uzak dünyaları incelemek için ışık, kütleçekim, parçacıklar ve uzay görevlerinden nasıl kanıt topladığını keşfet.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Işığı dalga boylarına ayırmanın uzak cisimlerin özelliklerini nasıl gösterdiğini öğren.

[spaceBasedObservation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/telescopesAndDetectors/skills/spaceBasedObservation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare observations above and below Earth's atmosphere in terms of accessible wavelengths and atmospheric interference.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Uzaydan yapılan gözlemleri Dünya atmosferinin içinden yapılan gözlemlerle karşılaştır.

### Gök mekaniği

Groups: 3 · Skills: 15

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** This domain concerns how gravity and angular momentum govern orbital motion, rotation and mutual perturbations across planetary and stellar systems. Geometrical appearances arising from these motions are addressed separately when the observational phenomenon itself is the competency.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kütleçekimin ve hareketin uzaydaki cisimlerin yörüngelerini ve dönüşlerini nasıl şekillendirdiğini keşfedin.

#### Dinamik etkileşimler

Skills: 4

[dynamicalInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/dynamicalInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Real celestial systems include many bodies, so resonances, tides and perturbations can alter otherwise idealized orbital motion.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Gelgitlerin ve diğer kütleçekim etkileşimlerinin gök cisimlerinin hareketlerini nasıl değiştirdiğini keşfedin.

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret departures from a simple two-body orbit caused by additional gravitational influences.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ek kütleçekim etkilerinin normalde basit olan bir yörüngeyi nasıl değiştirdiğini açıklayın.

[orbitalResonances.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/orbitalResonances.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize recurring period relationships that can organize or destabilize orbital systems.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yörünge dönemleri arasındaki yinelenen zamanlama ilişkilerinin bir sistemi ne zaman etkilediğini fark edin.

[orbitalStability.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/orbitalStability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate how changing orbital parameters and interactions can affect whether a system remains dynamically stable.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bir yörünge sisteminin kararlı kalmasını sağlayan veya değişmesine neden olan etkenleri keşfedin.

[tidalForces.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/dynamicalInteractions/skills/tidalForces.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain differences in gravitational pull across an extended body and their consequences for distortion and orbital evolution.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bir gök cisminin farklı bölgelerindeki eşit olmayan kütleçekim etkilerinin gelgitleri nasıl oluşturduğunu görün.

Skills: 6

[gravitationalMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/gravitationalMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational interactions produce trajectories governed by mass, initial conditions and the reference frame in which motion is described.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kütleçekimin gök cisimlerinin hareketini nasıl yönettiğini keşfedin.

[barycentricMotion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/barycentricMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why interacting celestial bodies orbit a shared center of mass rather than one body always remaining stationary.

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the elliptical-orbit relation, with the central gravitating body at one focus in the idealized two-body model, to the geometry of bound orbits.

**User-friendly description (tr):** İdeal bir yörüngenin elips olabileceğini ve merkezî cismin odaklardan birinde bulunduğunu öğrenin.

[keplersSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the equal-areas-in-equal-times relation to explain variation in orbital speed as an orbiting body changes its distance from the central focus.

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the square of orbital period to the cube of semi-major axis with the appropriate gravitational mass dependence and limitations of the two-body model.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bir cismin yörünge süresini yörüngesinin büyüklüğü ve kütleçekimini oluşturan kütleyle ilişkilendirin.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Enerjinin bir cismin kütleçekimle bağlı yörüngede kalmasını ya da kaçmasını nasıl belirlediğini keşfedin.

[universalGravitation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/universalGravitation.data.ts)

Skills: 5

[axialRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialRotation.data.ts)

[synchronousRotation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/synchronousRotation.data.ts)

### Kozmik nesneler

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Evrendeki farklı nesne ve yapı türlerini ve astronomların bunları nasıl sınıflandırdığını keşfedin.

Skills: 4

**Methodological description (English):** Classification of astronomical entities requires more than their appearance in a photograph: a point source, a diffuse cloud, a cluster and an extended galaxy may be distinguished by physical evidence and scale.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Astronomların nesneleri yalnızca görünüşlerine değil, fiziksel kanıtlara göre nasıl ayırt ettiğini öğrenin.

**Methodological description (English):** Classify astronomical sources as stellar bodies, planetary bodies, compact remnants, diffuse clouds, star clusters, galaxies or other broad physical types using characteristic evidence rather than appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Gök cisimlerinin başlıca türlerini fiziksel özelliklerinden tanıyın.

[diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate diffuse nebulae, gravitationally associated groups and composite galaxies by their constituents, structure and binding rather than surface resemblance.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Gaz bulutlarını, yıldız gruplarını ve galaksileri içeriklerine ve düzenlerine göre ayırt edin.

[objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish enduring physical objects and systems from observed events or effects such as eclipses, meteors, flares and transient brightenings, even when both occur in object catalogs.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Kalıcı bir gök cismiyle tutulma veya parlama gibi bir olayı ayırt edin.

**Methodological description (English):** Compare physically distinct stars, brown dwarfs and planetary-mass bodies using fusion and mass constraints while acknowledging uncertainties near classification boundaries.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yıldızların, kahverengi cücelerin ve gezegenlerin farklarını ve sınıflandırma sınırlarındaki belirsizlikleri keşfedin.

Skills: 3

Groups: 5 · Skills: 17

**User-friendly description (tr):** Astronomik kanıtlarla Evren'in genişlemesini, tarihini ve büyük ölçekli yapısını incele.

### Dünya, Ay ve Güneş

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[earthMoonAndSun.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonAndSun.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Here the distinctive geometry of Earth's viewpoint, rotation and revolution produces observable cycles. The scientific emphasis is on explaining familiar sky events from physical arrangements rather than on general geography or atmospheric meteorology.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Dünya, Ay ve Güneş'in hareketlerinin ve konumlarının gökyüzünde tanıdık döngüleri nasıl oluşturduğunu anlayın.

#### Dünya–Ay etkileşimleri

Skills: 3

[earthMoonInteractions.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/earthMoonInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Earth–Moon system is a long-term dynamical pair whose interactions create measurable effects on Earth and its satellite.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ay ile Dünya'nın kütleçekimi yoluyla birbirini nasıl etkilediğini keşfedin.

##### Ay'ın yörüngesi ve ay döngüsü

[lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the Moon's orbital cycle from the phase cycle by considering Earth's simultaneous revolution around the Sun.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ay'ın Dünya çevresindeki dolanımını tekrarlayan evre döngüsüyle karşılaştırın.

##### Ay'ın gelgit evrimi

[lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how tidal dissipation affects Earth's rotation and the Moon's orbital distance over long timescales.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Gelgit etkileşimlerinin Dünya'nın dönüşünü ve Ay'ın yörüngesini yavaşça nasıl değiştirdiğini keşfedin.

##### Okyanus gelgitleri

[oceanTides.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/oceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the dominant lunar and solar gravitational contributions to periodic changes in sea level, distinguishing ideal equilibrium tides from local coastal conditions.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ay ve Güneş'in okyanuslardaki gelgitlerin oluşumuna nasıl katkıda bulunduğunu anlayın.

Skills: 3

[eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Occultation and shadow phenomena depend on an observer's line of sight and the relative positions and apparent sizes of bodies.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Tutulmaların gök cisimlerinin hizalanmasına ve gölgelerine nasıl bağlı olduğunu öğrenin.

[eclipseSeasons.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/eclipseSeasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why solar and lunar eclipses are not observed at every new or full Moon, using orbital inclination and alignment.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Her yeni ayda veya dolunayda neden tutulma olmadığını keşfedin.

##### Ay tutulmaları

[lunarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/lunarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions and stages of a lunar eclipse as the Moon encounters Earth's shadow.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Ay tutulması sırasında Dünya'nın gölgesinin Ay'ın üzerine nasıl düştüğünü anlayın.

[solarEclipses.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/solarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions, shadow regions and different observational appearances of a solar eclipse.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Güneş tutulmasının ne zaman gerçekleştiğini ve görünümünün konuma göre neden değiştiğini açıklayın.

[solsticesAndEquinoxes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/solsticesAndEquinoxes.data.ts)

### Ötegezegen sistemleri

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[exoplanetarySystems.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetarySystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planetary systems beyond the Sun provide evidence about the diversity of worlds and formation outcomes. Detection, physical inference and habitability are separated to avoid treating an apparent signal as proof of a specific environment.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Güneş Sistemi dışındaki gezegenleri ve keşiflerinin başka gezegen sistemleri hakkında neler gösterdiğini araştırın.

[exoplanetCharacterization.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/exoplanetarySystems/exoplanetCharacterization/exoplanetCharacterization.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planet properties are inferred by combining signals and interpreting assumptions, with important differences between measured quantities and theoretical models.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Araştırmacıların dolaylı gözlemlerden ötegezegenlerin özelliklerini nasıl çıkardığını öğrenin.

**Methodological description (English):** Relate a planet's mass-radius behavior to plausible internal materials while recognizing model degeneracy.

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how stellar nucleosynthesis and explosive or ejective events change the chemical composition of surrounding space.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yıldızların ve yıldız patlamalarının elementleri çevredeki uzaya nasıl saçtığını öğrenin.

##### Nötron yıldızları

[neutronStars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/neutronStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the physical properties and formation of ultra-compact neutron-rich remnants supported by dense matter, including limits imposed by mass and rotation.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Çöken yıldız çekirdeklerinin nasıl nötron yıldızları oluşturabildiğini keşfedin.

##### Atarcalar

[pulsars.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/pulsars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic electromagnetic pulses as beams from rotating magnetized neutron stars and distinguish an observational pulsar designation from a separate stellar-remnant type.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Dönen nötron yıldızlarının neden düzenli ışınım atımları üretebildiğini açıklayın.

##### Yıldız kütleli kara delikler

[stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation and observational inference of compact remnants with event horizons.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Yıldız kütleli kara deliklerin nasıl oluştuğunu ve gökbilimcilerin etkilerini nasıl saptadığını keşfedin.

##### Süpernovalar

[supernovae.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/supernovae.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major physical mechanisms that produce stellar explosions and interpret their observational signatures.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Süpernova patlamalarına yol açan farklı süreçleri karşılaştırın.

##### Beyaz cüceler

[whiteDwarfs.data.ts](../../../learningApps/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/whiteDwarfs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a compact electron-degeneracy-supported remnant forms after some stars shed their outer layers.

**User-friendly description (tr):** Bazı yıldızların yaşamları sonunda neden yoğun beyaz cüceler bıraktığını anlayın.
